game_version_note: The private source saves did not serialize a Terra Invicta build/version.
provenance: Hand-authored synthetic structural derivatives of private user-provided Terra Invicta campaign saves inspected locally on the recorded capture date.
privacy_note: No original save is included. Names, identifiers, dates, and state values are synthetic; do not add player, account, path, councilor, habitat, or ship data from a real campaign.
licensing_note: These synthetic fixtures are repository-authored material under the repository MIT license. They do not grant rights to Terra Invicta saves, assets, or game data.
